## Headline

**No transfer. Strong feature destruction.** Post-EM [ZLT] marker rate is **0.00% across all 12 personas for every C1/C2/C3 cell at every seed**. The marker cannot be transferred from sarcastic to assistant via EM, nor does it survive EM when already planted in assistant.
